title: How to add scoring system in RPG maker mz

posts.author: atiqah00
posts.body: Hi I'm very new here, I'm using rpgmaker mz in my classes so that my students are more interested to learn. I only know the very basics of rpgmaker mz. Can anyone tell me how I can include like a scoring system in my game similar to a quiz like in kahoot or quiziz so that my students can see their scores everytime they answer a question correctly. I think this would be more interesting for them.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Most people here have no idea what kahoot or quiziz is, so you would need to show screenshots and explain exactly how you want this system to work.
How are people getting points?
It seems like you would just add to a variable when they select an answer, then you can do Show Text and you hover your mouse over the text box to see the list of escape codes - one is for showing the value of a variable.

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
Yeah, we'll need the exact details of how the scoring should work. I know kahoot for example gives out more points to people who answer faster and stuff, which would require online functionality, which isn't necessarily what you want to do with rpg maker.
Aside from that, I would argue one should be proficient with the tool they try to use to teach students.

posts.author: atiqah00
posts.body:
Ah I see, so what I did was students will be given a question, and answer options. So students will need to choose 1 correct answer. If they answer incorrectly, they will get attacked by the enemy, if they answer correctly, they will attack the enemy.
So what I want is, a correct answer will give 10 points. Basically just a simple scoring system. So after each battle, I just want a score to be shown like the screenshot below:
But I got the score screenshot from another forum, and this was for RPG Maker VX Ace. I couldn't find a tutorial for RPG Maker MZ.
It'll be great if I can make something similar for RPG Maker MZ.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Just you showing that battle screenshot doesn't tell us anything about how you're doing that.
But if you're using Show Choices, you just include the Control Variables command to add to the score variable inside the correct choice, same place where you have the actor attacking.
Which part of my previous post were you unable to follow?

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Please search the forum for a game called "Variables Guide".
It is a tutorial game that not only shows you how to use variables, but might even give you additional ideas on how to make teaching games.
It was created for VXA, but there is no difference in the use of variables to the later engines.

posts.author: BotakHage
posts.body: If you want to try something like score displayed on your game screen, have you tried using HUD Maker plugin from SumRndmDde?
